description.value: A Taco Bell franchise location in Surrey offering Tex-Mex fast food including tacos, burritos, and the Crunchwrap Supreme. The location features both dine-in and drive-thru service, making it accessible for cyclists who prefer not to lock up and enter. A dedicated Veggie Cravings Menu offers vegetarian options for plant-based riders.
